choang.A: Same soft hand-painted storybook style, same round gold-rimmed medallion and same chibi proportions as the reference, but the person is now a young CONSORT (imperial concubine) of the inner palace, a graceful woman about twenty-two with a soft pretty face, black hair in a neat elegant bun with two gold hairpins, a small pearl hair ornament and one small pink flower (no crown, no phoenix), a jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with an ivory (#F1E6D2) collar and light gold embroidery at the shoulders. choang.out: Hand-painted storybook animation, static camera, flat chroma green background stays perfectly flat green the whole time. The young consort with the gold hairpins inside the round gold medallion is stunned: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, both hands go limp on the rim, she stares blankly straight ahead with dull eyes and her mouth slightly open, a small faint grey cloud appears above her head; she comes out of the round frame only a little toward the viewer. Small calm movements only, exactly two hands, no big arms, the medallion keeps exactly its same size and colour. Smooth, cartoon-like, same painted style, no camera move, no new objects.
